# THE SILENT LIST [color=#5F6B70]Pinned thread. Stations that stopped transmitting, or never really started.[/color]
### #1 relay_widow (OP) // 83.02.09 One line per station. Last confirmed traffic, who confirmed it, what the official word was. If you add one, say how you know.
- [bold]Oxley's Butte, Raijin (LV-670).[/bold] 2175. Repeated calls for xenoarchaeology and xenofauna specialists. Company line: false alarm. Then a run of TWE parliament scandals buried it. Who asks for a xenofauna specialist by accident? - [bold]Solaris Gulch (LV-747).[/bold] About 120 heads on the books. Labs Eta and Lambda went from lichen to sample storage to, rumour says, shut. Upkeep still paid. You pay to keep a door shut. - [bold]Corsat Station.[/bold] Never spoke to the public. Press barred. Listed for completeness. - [bold]Wherever the Hope's Retreat transport was going.[/bold] Passengers turned around mid-voyage and told their destination was gone. I cannot find its name published anywhere.
### #2 ninth_shift // 83.02.11 Add the Sorokyne mining outpost. Not silent exactly. I worked relay there. The research side chatters all day. The miners only ever send ration counts, routed through Sestra Solutions. From one fortnight to the next the count dropped by eleven. No accident report.
### #3 static_saint // 83.02.14 Kutjevo. The central aquifers ran dry, fine. Dry wells do not need a level three biohazard containment lab built next to them. Show me another water plant with one.
### #4 relay_widow (OP) // 83.02.14 Logged. Rule stands: bottles are not evidence. Times and frequencies are.
### #5 guest_0419 // 83.03.01 My brother signed on at a mine on Chances Claim. Crime wave, they said, so Company security took over. His letters came every forty days. The last two were the same letter, same words, same smudge on the scan. Then nothing. If anyone is on LV-522, just tell me the mine is open.
### #6 relay_widow (OP) // 83.03.01 I am sorry. Added and flagged personal. Two identical letters is a pattern we have seen before. That is what an autoresponder sends.
